column1: # accept-gate cell registry (tools/accept-gate.sh). TAB-separated.
#   id
# A CELL IS A SERVED CONFIG, not a model. The law this registry encodes
# (research/f8f4-flip-20260806/MATRIX.md): the acceptance sign follows
# (model x drafter x prompt), NOT the model — it INVERTED between the GGUF's embedded MTP head
# and the production regime drafter on the same two models the same day. So every row names the
# artifact's REAL production drafter (attached via MEMRA_MODELS "+draft", which REPLACES the
# embedded head at load) and its real serve K. A bare-head number is not evidence about a served
# config and has no row here.
# spec-k: the K the artifact actually SERVES (both production servers default K=3 —
# worker.rs:3251 MEMRA_SPEC_K default, and tools/serve-examples/serve-qwen36-27b-memra leaves it
# at the default). Gating a K the config never serves would measure an unserved path.
# ctx: deliberately SMALL (8192) compared to the 128k production window. This gate asserts
# acceptance + text exactness, which are ctx-independent at these prompt lengths (the longest
# prompt here is ~5.4k tokens), and a 128k session costs ~4.1GB of KV plus a slow boot for zero
# added assertion strength. The 128k window has its own gates (serve-smoke, serve-stress).
# ngen: >=100 BY CONTRACT. The blind spot this gate closes is that the token goldens stop at 20
# and the receipted greedy divergences landed at generated index 22 and 38. 128 is ~6.4x the
# golden window and comfortably past both. Never lower a cell below 100.
# tier: `smoke` cells run in the DEFAULT battery arm (local-ci keeps it near ~3 min: ONE model,
# ONE K, one prompt — the q27 p1 cell, which is the cell the receipted arm move is loudest on:
# rounds 42->43, drafted 126->129, accepted 85->85, text sha fddd52f5->33d69474). `full` cells
# run under --full and add the second model (q9, whose regime cell carried the worst -9.5pp) and
# the prompt-length axis (28 / 1845 / 5411 prompt tokens) — acceptance is prompt-dependent, so a
# one-length matrix would be the weakest version of this gate.
# --- q27: Qwen3.6-27B NVFP4+MTP + daily regime drafter (the owner's default engine, port 8002).
#     504/866 NVFP4 tensors — one of only 2 of 12 gate models the f8f4 arm can even reach.
# --- q9: Qwen3.5-9B NVFP4+MTP + its regime drafter (114/668 NVFP4; the other reachable model).
#     q9-p1 is the -9.5pp cell: acceptance 0.7236 -> 0.6288 under the arm, with the OFF==OFF2
#     control green — i.e. the arm, not box drift.
